title: VGroup
author: DeepBuild
description: VGroup(*members) as a frame@1 its members hang from: arrange as a row or a column with buff between, arrange_in_grid as a grid; `<id>[i]` names member i at check. a unit is the frame's short side ÷ 8 in u (fw, fh), so the frame is 14.22 × 8 units at 16:9; y flips and the origin moves to the frame's center; radians become degrees; a stroke width w becomes w × unit ÷ 100 u; font_size f is an em of f ÷ 96 units.

members.about: the IDs of the items it groups, in order

arrange.about: arrange(direction): a row or a column

move_to.about: move_to: the point the shape's center goes to, in units, y up from the frame's center

next_to.about: next_to: the ID of the item it sits beside, by a relation, never a computed place; none for none

to_edge.about: to_edge: UP, DOWN, LEFT or RIGHT, or {edge, buff}

to_corner.about: to_corner: UL, UR, DL or DR, or {corner, buff}

edge_buff.about: to_edge and to_corner's buff in units (DEFAULT_MOBJECT_TO_EDGE_BUFFER)

align_to.about: align_to: the ID of the item whose edge it lines up with; none for none

scale.about: scale: the factor about the shape's center

rotate.about: rotate: the angle in radians, counterclockwise; it becomes degrees, clockwise in u

flip.about: flip: mirrored across its vertical axis

let.nx: (direction == RIGHT || direction == UR || direction == DR) ? 1 : ((direction == LEFT || direction == UL || direction == DL) ? -1 : 0)
let.ny: ((direction == UP || direction == UL || direction == UR) ? 1 : ((direction == DOWN || direction == DL || direction == DR) ? -1 : 0)) * ys
let.ex: (edge_word == RIGHT || edge_word == UR || edge_word == DR) ? 1 : ((edge_word == LEFT || edge_word == UL || edge_word == DL) ? -1 : 0)
let.ey: ((edge_word == UP || edge_word == UL || edge_word == UR) ? 1 : ((edge_word == DOWN || edge_word == DL || edge_word == DR) ? -1 : 0)) * ys
let.kx: (corner_word == RIGHT || corner_word == UR || corner_word == DR) ? 1 : ((corner_word == LEFT || corner_word == UL || corner_word == DL) ? -1 : 0)
let.ky: ((corner_word == UP || corner_word == UL || corner_word == UR) ? 1 : ((corner_word == DOWN || corner_word == DL || corner_word == DR) ? -1 : 0)) * ys
let.ax: (aligned_edge == RIGHT || aligned_edge == UR || aligned_edge == DR) ? 1 : ((aligned_edge == LEFT || aligned_edge == UL || aligned_edge == DL) ? -1 : 0)
let.ay: ((aligned_edge == UP || aligned_edge == UL || aligned_edge == UR) ? 1 : ((aligned_edge == DOWN || aligned_edge == DL || aligned_edge == DR) ? -1 : 0)) * ys
let.beside_align: aligned_edge == none ? center : ((ny != 0) ? (ax > 0 ? end : (ax < 0 ? start : center)) : (ay > 0 ? end : (ay < 0 ? start : center)))
let.has_place: next_to != none || corner_word != none || edge_word != none
let.placed: next_to != none ? beside : (corner_word != none ? corner : edge)
let.free: next_to == none && corner_word == none && edge_word == none
let.mode: len(arrange_in_grid) == 2 ? grid : ((arrange == RIGHT || arrange == LEFT) ? row : (arrange == none ? none : column))

refuses.center: Leave it out: the group's frame is placed by move_to and the layout words.
refuses.col_alignments: Leave it out: grid cells center their members.
refuses.row_alignments: Leave it out: grid cells center their members.
refuses.use_vectorized: Leave it out: every math@1 shape is a path the renderer strokes and fills on its own.
refuses.sheen_factor: Leave it out: a flat fill has no sheen; use a gradient fill through the look.
refuses.sheen_direction: Leave it out: a flat fill has no sheen; use a gradient fill through the look.
refuses.background_stroke_width: Leave it out, or draw a second, wider copy beneath in the background color.
refuses.background_stroke_color: Leave it out, or draw a second, wider copy beneath in the background color.
refuses.joint_type: Leave it out: paths join by the look's line style.
refuses.cap_style: Leave it out: paths cap by the look's line style.
refuses.shade_in_3d: Leave it out: 2D shapes draw flat; for a lit shape use math.surface.
